description: This Java class implements a pipeline function 'filter' for processing data streams, providing filtering functionality based on RQL functions and parameters within a data processing pipeline. It defines the logic for how to parse parameters, resolve expressions, and apply filtering conditions.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter
classes.description: Provides the implementation of the 'filter' pipeline function for data filtering based on RQL functions.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.FilterFunctionSignature
classes.description: Singleton class describing the signature of the filter function, including parameter definitions.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.FilterValueParam
classes.description: Parameter definition for the filter value.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.RqlFunctionParam
classes.description: Parameter definition for the RQL function used for filtering.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.ComparedValueParam
classes.description: Parameter definition for the value to compare against the filter value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function ('filter').

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature object describing the parameter structure of the function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the filter function to a pipeline element, performing filtering based on parameters and RQL function.

methods.name: parseAndResolve
methods.description: Parses the parameter string, resolves placeholders, and returns a map of parameter names to values.
